issues.message: Impact data uses two incompatible units. 9 rows are J/m (energy per width) and cannot be compared with the kJ/m² rows without specimen geometry. They must not share a chart axis.
25 of 69 HDT headlines cite a source that names the standard but not the load. They carry loadStated:false and must not be presented as confirmed 0.45 MPa values.
3 peer spans were derived for missing headlines. Same polymer and modifier only; these observations never confirm or exclude a material.
5 materials have no property measurements at all: PA66, PA66-CF, PA612, PA612-GF, POM / Acetal
